'''Davi''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Sarria Jevad]] sent out Davi on a scouting mission, but Davi did not return to the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]].
